paragraphs: It was ten o'clock at night, and the house was quiet. Lily was thirsty, so she went to the kitchen. Tom stood in front of the kitchen cupboard. "What are you doing, Tom?" asked Lily. "I can't sleep," said Tom. "I'm hungry." "Dad bought pancakes at the market this morning," said Lily. "They're on the plate on the table." "Good idea," said Tom. "Where's the water?"

"It's at the bottom of the cupboard," said Lily. "Next to the rice." She took a bottle and a glass. Lily drank some water, and Tom ate a pancake. "Don't talk loudly," said Tom. "Mom and Dad are asleep." Then Pip ran in and said, "Woof! Woof!" very loudly. "Pip, be quiet!" said Lily. Pip looked at the window and said, "Woof!" again. Tom looked out of the window, too. "It's only a cat on the wall," he said.

Dad came into the kitchen with a tired face. "What's that noise?" he asked. "Sorry, Dad," said Tom. "This is the worst night. We can't sleep." Dad looked at them, and then he smiled. "Come with me," he said. He opened the door to the garden. "Look at the sky!" said Dad. "Wow! There are so many stars!" said Lily. They sat on the grass with pancakes and water. Pip sat next to them and looked at the sky, too. Now Tom and Lily were not hungry, and the night was quiet again.
text.summary: Lily is thirsty at night, and Tom is hungry. Pip wakes Dad with a loud bark, and Dad takes the children outside to look at the stars.
